capacityPolicy.warningAction: schedule independently reviewed compaction analysis and verify backup/migration budgets
capacityPolicy.criticalAction: fail closed for new reservation admission until capacity is restored or an approved extension is provisioned

destructiveCompactionPrerequisites: the exact operation scope ID, operation ID and semantic digest are named
AuthBus reservation state is terminal and its settlement or terminal-evidence digest is retained
kernel.operations has an independently observed terminal row for the same operation identity and owner generation
the operation identity reuse window has elapsed
all backup, restore, incident-investigation and canary-rollback windows have elapsed
an immutable audit-export receipt covers the canonical archive row or a collision-resistant tombstone
all retained backup generations that still reference the full row are catalogued
a distinct operator approves the compaction manifest
post-compaction exact-frontier and restore verification succeed

jointDeletionProtocol.requiredDecision: same signed compaction manifest and exact operation identity

requiredMeasurements: migration duration, temporary bytes and rollback duration
